question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cosecant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-6\operatorname{arcsch}⁡(3x-1)) \\  & =6\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡(3x-1)) \\  & =6\cdot (-\frac{1}{|3x-1|\sqrt{1+(3x-1)^{2}}})\cdot (3x-1)^{′} \\  & =-6\cdot \frac{1}{|3x-1|\sqrt{1+9{x}^{2}-6x+1}}\cdot 3 \\  & =-\frac{18}{|3x-1|\sqrt{9{x}^{2}-6x+2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
